why.zh: 模型给出的范围；在所测的极值处深部结构穿出皮肤的比例与默认相同（缩放对皮肤和深部结构一视同仁）。
why.en: The range given by the model; at the extremes measured, deep parts come through the skin no more than at the default (the scales treat skin and deep parts alike).

why.zh: 下限：BMI 再低，皮肤就会收到肌肉和骨以内——肌肉不随 BMI 变细，深部结构穿出皮肤超过 2 mm 的采样点比例会比默认（0.1%）多出 1 个百分点以上；也不低于胖瘦场表格的最小值 18.5。上限：胖瘦场表格的最大值 40。
why.en: Lower bound: below it the skin would shrink inside muscle and bone — muscles do not thin with BMI, and the share of sampled deep-part vertices more than 2 mm outside the skin would exceed the default (0.1 %) by more than 1 percentage points; nor below 18.5, the lowest BMI of the fat-field table. Upper bound: 40, the highest BMI of the table.

why.zh: 模型给出的范围；在所测的极值处深部结构穿出皮肤的比例与默认相同（缩放对皮肤和深部结构一视同仁）。
why.en: The range given by the model; at the extremes measured, deep parts come through the skin no more than at the default (the scales treat skin and deep parts alike).

name.zh: 体型分布（腰腹型–四肢型）

why.zh: 模型给出的范围；在所测的极值处深部结构穿出皮肤的比例与默认相同（缩放对皮肤和深部结构一视同仁）。
why.en: The range given by the model; at the extremes measured, deep parts come through the skin no more than at the default (the scales treat skin and deep parts alike).

rules.zh: 骨、肌肉、内脏、深部血管神经：只随所绑定关节的节段缩放（身高、腿长比例、体型分布），不随 BMI 改变。
rules.en: Bones, muscles, viscera, deep vessels and nerves: follow the segment scales of the joints they are bound to (stature, relative leg length, mass distribution) and do not change with BMI.

rules.zh: 皮肤：先按 BMI 加上胖瘦位移（m(bmi)·fat，逐顶点限幅），再随关节缩放和姿势。
rules.en: Skin: first the fatness displacement for the BMI (m(bmi)·fat, capped per vertex), then the joint scales and the pose.

rules.zh: 皮下脂肪：每个顶点跟随最近皮肤顶点位移的一部分，份额 = 到深层（肌、骨）的距离 /（到深层的距离 + 到皮肤的距离）：贴皮肤的一面全跟，贴肌肉的一面不动。
rules.en: Subcutaneous fat: every vertex follows a share of the displacement of its nearest skin vertex, share = distance to the deep layer (muscle, bone) / (that distance + distance to the skin): the face under the skin follows fully, the face on the muscle stays.

rules.zh: 浅层血管、神经、筋膜：距皮肤 10 mm 以内的顶点按 1 − 深度/10 mm 的份额跟随皮肤；毛发、眉、耳廓、指甲完全跟随皮肤。
rules.en: Superficial vessels, nerves and fasciae: vertices within 10 mm of the skin follow it by a share of 1 − depth/10 mm; hair, eyebrows, external ears and nails follow the skin fully.

cautions.zh: 体型的四个控制量来自人体测量回归（ANSUR II、NHANES，美国数据），不是个体预测；默认值就是这副身体原样。
cautions.en: The four shape controls come from anthropometric regressions (ANSUR II, NHANES; US data), not from a prediction for an individual; the defaults are this body as built.

cautions.zh: BMI 只改变皮肤和皮下脂肪：肌肉、骨和内脏不变。BMI 升高时内脏脂肪、乳房和腹腔内容物的变化没有建模；BMI 降低到可用下限以下会让肌肉穿出皮肤，所以被限制。
cautions.en: BMI changes skin and subcutaneous fat only: muscles, bones and viscera stay as they are. Visceral fat, the breasts and the abdominal contents are not modelled as BMI rises; below the valid lower bound muscles would come through the skin, hence the limit.

cautions.zh: 身高和比例通过各关节节段的缩放实现：骨沿长轴拉长、按围度因子略微变粗；骨盆只在横向变宽（骶骨被放大而髋骨只是平移），躯干长度全部由腰椎和胸椎承担，肋骨整体等比缩放。这些是为了便宜而作的近似。
cautions.en: Stature and proportions are realised by per-joint segment scales: bones lengthen along their axis and thicken slightly by the girth factor; the pelvis widens transversely only (the sacrum is scaled while the hip bones merely shift), trunk length is carried entirely by the lumbar and thoracic vertebrae, and ribs scale uniformly. These are approximations chosen for cheapness.

cautions.zh: 体型分布（腰腹型–四肢型）目前只通过各节段横截面的缩放表现，没有专门的皮肤位移场，效果很弱。
cautions.en: Mass distribution (waist-heavy versus limb-heavy) is expressed only through the cross-section scales of the segments, without a displacement field of its own; its effect is weak.
